data.one_liner: Flutter package to manage app configurations via a singleton pattern.
data.what_it_does: Loads configuration data from a Map or JSON file and stores it in a global singleton. Provides get, set, and unset methods to access nested config values using dot‑separated paths.
use_when: You need a simple, centralized place for runtime configuration values.
You want to load configs from assets or code without additional tooling.
avoid_when: You require reactive updates when config changes.
You need secure or encrypted storage for sensitive data.
strengths: Very easy to integrate and use.
Supports nested paths for hierarchical configs.
Works on all Flutter platforms out of the box.
weaknesses: Manual type casting required for custom types.

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a lightweight way to load and parse configuration files without a singleton wrapper.
